metadata.title: Ramification and Finiteness of Equivariant Minimal Surfaces
metadata.abstract: Let $S$ be a closed oriented surface of genus $g$, with $g\ \geq \ 2$, and let $\mathcal X_0^{\mathrm{good}}$ be the good locus of $\operatorname{PU}(2,\,1)$ representations with Toledo invariant zero. For $1\ \leq \ b\ \leq\ 2g-3$, we show that representations admitting an equivariant minimal map of total ramification at least $b$, for some marked complex structure, form a countable union of compact null sets of Hausdorff dimension at most $16g-16-2b$. For larger $b$, this locus is empty. Consequently, on a dense $G_\delta$ subset of full measure in $\mathcal X_0^{\mathrm{good}}$, every nonconstant equivariant minimal map is an immersion, for every marked complex structure. On the convex cocompact locus, a dense $G_\delta$ subset of full measure consists of representations admitting a finite nonempty set of marked equivariant minimal immersions.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 对闭曲面群的良好 PU(2,1) 表示，研究随标记复结构变化的等变极小曲面分歧及有限性。
techniques: 表示空间的 Hausdorff 维数估计
analysis.breakthrough: Toledo 不变量为零时，分歧阶至少 b 的例外集合维数至多 16g−16−2b；获得泛性浸入结论及凸余紧情形的有限非空性。
analysis.limitations: 曲面属数至少 2；结论有良好表示、Toledo 零与凸余紧等各自条件，泛性结论不意味着所有表示均如此。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 量化退化表示的余维，并连接极小曲面的泛性与有限性。
